correctness.rationale: Each weight-one strand with its 1 at i emits prefix/suffix length n-1 reads, so pooled labelled read-word multiplicities satisfy y_j=x_j+x_(j+1), with all-zero count fixed by k. The integer kernel is z_i=(-1)^(i-1)t. For odd n, fixed sum k forces t=0; for even n=2m fibers are integer translates with a unique representative of min odd coordinate zero. For size>=s, subtract s-1 from all m even coordinates and require at least one odd coordinate zero: T_s=B_n(k-m(s-1))-B_n(k-ms). Thus H(s)=T_s-T_(s+1), total R=B_n(k)-B_n(k-m), largest fiber 1+floor(k/m), first ambiguity at k=m one double fiber. For k growing, finite binomial difference gives R~m*k^(n-2)/(n-2)!. Independent literal-read multisets checked 42 n,k pairs (n=2..8,k=0..5) and n=4,k=4 histogram 16 singletons,8 doubles,1 triple.

value.rationale: Precisely identifies when pooled longest reads lose reconstructibility and how many source multisets are confusable at every finite size, delivering exact zero-error code size and a natural parity obstruction for a standard sparse DNA-storage channel. A complete distribution, not an arbitrary small-instance computation.
